subject.title: Plugin UI: add scoped action bridge for sandboxed tabs

question: Should OpenClaw publish this new cross-layer Plugin SDK/Gateway contract for sandboxed external tabs, after narrowing `contextTokens` to Gateway-owned state?
rationale: The patch adds durable plugin descriptor capabilities and an authenticated browser-to-Gateway action path; source review cannot determine whether this permanent API direction is desired.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed bridge
options.body: Approve the capability after Gateway-owned context derivation, focused boundary tests, and exact-head runtime proof are supplied.

options.title: Decline the bridge contract
options.body: Keep external tabs read-only and direct plugin authors to existing authenticated parent or bearer surfaces instead of adding this API.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrowed bridge
recommendation.body: Approve the capability after Gateway-owned context derivation, focused boundary tests, and exact-head runtime proof are supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged external-tab authentication boundary that this proposal extends.
